definitions.explanation: Describes something that is physically or temporally very far away. Often evokes a poetic or wistful tone.
Used to emphasize a large difference in degree when making comparisons.

examples.japanese: {遥|はる}か{遠|とお}く⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{山|やま}→山：02168_yama⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{見|み}える→見える：01165_mieru⟧。
examples.english: Mountains are visible far in the distance.

examples.japanese: {遥|はる}か⟦{昔|むかし}→昔：01515_mukashi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ことだ。
examples.english: That was a long, long time ago.

examples.japanese: ⟦{空港|くうこう}→空港：00648_kuukou⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{遥|はる}か⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{続|つづ}く→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧⟦{砂漠|さばく}→砂漠：09508_sabaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{眺|なが}めた→眺める：02132_nagameru⟧。
examples.english: I gazed at the desert stretching far beyond the airport.

examples.japanese: ⟦{実際|じっさい}→実際：02502_jissai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{予想|よそう}→予想：03664_yosou⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧{遥|はる}か⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{難|むずか}しかった→難しい：00517_muzukashii⟧。
examples.english: In reality, it was far more difficult than expected.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧{遥|はる}か⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧おいしい。
examples.english: The food at this restaurant is far better than at that one.

notes:
{遥|はる}か can function as both an adverb and a na-adjective.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {遥|はる}か⟦{遠|とお}く→遠い：00529_tooi⟧: far in the distance
- {遥|はる}か⟦{昔|むかし}→昔：01515_mukashi⟧: a long time ago
- {遥|はる}か⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ + comparative: far more ~, by far ~
- {遥|はる}かな + noun: distant ~, far-off ~

USAGE: When modifying a noun directly, use the na-adjective form ({遥|はる}かな). When modifying a verb or adjective, use the adverbial form ({遥|はる}か⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧). The word often carries a literary or poetic nuance, evoking a sense of longing or vastness.
